Simple purées

Pumpkin purée

Sütőtökpüré

6 months+ Sound idea 35 min 4 portions

Offer a few teaspoons on a spoon, and thin it if it sits too thick.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 320 g pumpkin (prepared weight, peeled and seeded)
  • 4 tbsp breast milk, formula, or water (just enough to blend smooth)

Allergens

none

Method

  1. Peel the pumpkin, scrape out the seeds, and cut the flesh into chunks.
  2. Steam for about 15 minutes, or bake at 200°C for about 25 minutes, until very soft.
  3. Blend with a spoon of breast milk, formula, or water until smooth.
  4. Cool until just warm.
  5. Do not add salt or sugar.

Sound idea

Salt or sugar is sometimes stirred into pumpkin, and a six-month-old does not need either.

No change is needed beyond keeping salt and sugar out. Bake or steam the pumpkin and loosen it with breast milk, formula, or water.
